notes: Text-only evaluation set for the A1.1 guided speaking missions. mission_order N == Lektion N of src/data/curricula/a11.js.
Every case is a transcript, never audio: the dataset tests the TEACHER (task decision, correction, register, safety), not acoustics. That is why every expected.mustNotClaim contains "pronunciation".

Roles: "assistant" is the coach (always Sie), "user" is the learner. The role "system" appears only in provider-failure cases and marks a failure the harness injects at that point in the turn sequence.

Criteria ids are mission-scoped labels (mNN.<goal>) derived from the Lektion can-dos. expected.taskCriteriaMet lists what THIS learner utterance should tick; expected.shouldPassMission says whether the mission is complete after it.

No personal data: only the course's own fictional figures (Ana Chakiri, Tim, Lena, Frau Kaya, Herr Schmidt, Frau Wolf, Herr Weber, Paul) and invented places. No real e-mail addresses, phone numbers or street addresses appear anywhere.
